name: Favorite Dear
original_name: フェイバリットディア
source:
Favorite Dear is a mix between a classic turn based rpg (specially in the battle parts) and an adventure simulation game in the story part. The player controls a young man that have to train himself and some young woman that will help him to gain strengh.

During the adventure he will have to solve some different missions and will have to battle against different kind of enemites. The characters story and his reactions will be a lot more complex the more that the player advance in the game. The adventure part is in first person perspective with 2d anime images and the battle part is in a third person isometric view.

[From [url=https://psxdatacenter.com/games/J/F/SLPS-01759.html]PlayStation Datacenter[/url]]
translation:
《勇者之光》在戰鬥部分採用經典的回合制角色扮演玩法，劇情部分則融入冒險模擬。玩家操縱一名年輕男子，在鍛鍊自己的同時，也要培養幾位將助他增強實力的年輕女性。

冒險途中，他需要完成各類任務，與不同種類的敵人交戰。隨著遊戲推進，人物的經歷和反應都會變得更加複雜。冒險部分採用第一人稱視角，配以二維動畫風格畫面；戰鬥則轉為第三人稱等距視角。

［摘自[url=https://psxdatacenter.com/games/J/F/SLPS-01759.html]PlayStation Datacenter[/url]］
